purpose: Hit the ball with a controlled, powerful groundstroke by turning the body, loading the legs, swinging the racket through contact in front of the body, and finishing balanced.

phases.description: From the ready position, shoulders and hips turn sideways and the racket is taken back.
Racket drops and loops behind while weight loads onto the back leg and knees flex.
Legs and hips drive, trunk uncoils, and the racket accelerates up and forward to contact in front of the body.
Arm continues across and up the body, finishing over the non-dominant shoulder with balance, then recovers.

objectives.goal: Turn the shoulders well past the hips during the unit turn and backswing to coil the body.

below.looks_like: Shoulders stay square to the net with an arm-only takeback.

above.looks_like: Over-rotated, trunk turned far back, hard to recover timing.

objectives.cue_intent: Prompt turning the chest sideways with the racket takeback.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether the player feels they turn their shoulders or just move the arm back.
objectives.fix_intent: Use the non-dominant hand to push the racket back so the shoulders turn with it.

objectives.goal: Bend the knees and sink the hips to load the legs before swinging forward.

above.looks_like: Standing tall with straight legs, hitting with the arm only.

below.looks_like: Very deep knee bend, slow to push up.

objectives.cue_intent: Encourage a small sink into the legs on the backswing.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask if the legs feel involved in the shot.
objectives.fix_intent: Cue bending the knees to get under the ball and push up through the shot.

objectives.goal: Meet the ball with the arm extended comfortably in front of the body, not jammed or late.

below.looks_like: Arm cramped close to the body, ball hit late or jammed.

above.looks_like: Overreaching with the arm straight and stretched away from the body.

objectives.cue_intent: Cue making contact out in front with room between body and racket.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether the ball feels close to the body at contact.
objectives.fix_intent: Prepare earlier and space from the ball so contact occurs in front.

objectives.goal: Uncoil the trunk so shoulders rotate through toward the target during the forward swing.

below.looks_like: Arm swings without body rotation, weak and arm-dominated stroke.

above.looks_like: Shoulders lag far behind the hips.

objectives.cue_intent: Cue turning the chest through to the target.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask if the swing feels like it comes from the body or the arm.
objectives.fix_intent: Drill hip and shoulder rotation with a controlled swing.

objectives.goal: Complete the swing with the racket arm high across the body and stay balanced.

below.looks_like: Swing stops short or low, no full finish.

above.looks_like: Racket wraps very high behind the head.

objectives.cue_intent: Cue finishing over the opposite shoulder.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether the player lets the racket finish or stops it.
objectives.fix_intent: Cue swinging all the way through and finishing high.

objectives.goal: Keep the trunk fairly upright and balanced over the feet through the stroke.

above.looks_like: Leaning sideways or falling back or away, off-balance contact.

objectives.cue_intent: Cue staying balanced and tall through contact.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask if the player feels off balance at the finish.
objectives.fix_intent: Improve footwork and base so the body stays stacked over the legs.

outcomes.description: The ball is struck cleanly with pace and accuracy toward the target.
The stroke is coordinated, balanced and repeatable.

links.mechanism: A fuller coil stores rotational energy that is released into the swing.
Leg flexion allows an upward drive that adds racket speed without losing stability.
Contact with the arm comfortably extended in front gives leverage and clean ball timing.

session_ideas: Shadow swings from the side view, focusing on turn and finish.
Feed-ball drill with a consistent contact point in front.
Slow-motion forehands with a pause at the loaded position.
Compare repetitions to check consistency of the finish height.
